comment: Golden vectors of the Ycash post-quantum signature library (src/crypto/pq/README.md has the format). Every field is lower-case hex of bytes in the order they appear on the wire or in memory; msg is the 32 bytes of a ZIP-243 sighash in memory order (uint256 begin..end). seed/entropy were derived from label (SHA512(label||ctr) chain), but consumers take the hex as given. Recomputed by src/test/pq_crypto_tests.cpp.
